newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Simsmetal to consolidate UK units.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Simsmetal to consolidate UK units.

text.p: Simsmetal Ltd said on Wednesday that it would consolidate its operations in the United Kingdom.
Simsmetal managing director John Crabb said in a statement that the company would consolidate its UK operations by integrating the Sims McIntyre Group and Sims Bird Ltd.
"This move will strengthen the Sims UK Group and provide additional efficiencies from a purchasing and marketing perspective," Crabb said.
He said that as a result of this integration, Simsmetal's equity in Sims Bird Ltd would increase to 69 percent from 51 percent with the remaining 31 percent held by the Bird Group.
